name: CRYSTALFIST-the-colour
note: The Protector's royal purple, not the reference's: two titles would share a colour and Flylighter's purple is lost.

name: CRYSTALFIST-a-bluer-purple
note: A violet, not the reference's #a349a4.

name: CRYSTALFIST-a-gradient
old: aegis: Object.freeze([OBLIVION_VOID, OBLIVION_VIOLET, OBLIVION_LILAC]),   // AEGIS: out of the void into the ward's light
new:
aegis: Object.freeze([OBLIVION_VOID, OBLIVION_VIOLET, OBLIVION_LILAC]),   // AEGIS: out of the void into the ward's light
  crystalfist: Object.freeze([OBLIVION_VOID, CRYSTAL_PURPLE]),
note: "the color 'gradient' would be unnecessary": one colour.

name: CRYSTALFIST-glyph-in-another-colour

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-mark

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-mark-another-glyphs

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-glyph-stroked

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-aura-not-granted

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-ring-on-the-body

name: CRYSTALFIST-a-wave-off-whole
old: export const RESONANCE_CRESTS = Object.freeze({ wave: 3, counter: 2 });
new: export const RESONANCE_CRESTS = Object.freeze({ wave: 3.5, counter: 2 });
note: A seam behind the wearer where the wave meets itself.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-bounce-frozen
note: Each column's own bounce frozen - the columns move with the waves alone.

name: CRYSTALFIST-a-slash-turned
note: The lower slash's end no longer square to it - the band bent.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-middle-short
note: The middle cut to the others' length: the reference's middle runs corner to corner.

name: CRYSTALFIST-a-slash-thicker
note: The upper slash thicker than the others.

name: CRYSTALFIST-a-slash-wound-back
note: Wound against the others.

name: CRYSTALFIST-a-corner-left-square
note: AUDIT: one corner of the lower slash square again - the reference's ends are rounded at every corner.

name: CRYSTALFIST-a-rate-off-whole
old: export const RESONANCE_HZ = Object.freeze({ wave: 61 / 120, counter: 41 / 120, bounce: 59 / 120, beat: 1 });
new: export const RESONANCE_HZ = Object.freeze({ wave: 61 / 120, counter: 41 / 120, bounce: 59 / 120, beat: 1.07 });
note: The beat steps the picture at the clock's wrap.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-rates-on-a-six-second-loop
old: export const RESONANCE_HZ = Object.freeze({ wave: 61 / 120, counter: 41 / 120, bounce: 59 / 120, beat: 1 });
new: export const RESONANCE_HZ = Object.freeze({ wave: 1 / 2, counter: 1 / 3, bounce: 1 / 2, beat: 1 });
note: AUDIT: the rates the slice shipped with: the whole ring repeated every six seconds, and two wearers six seconds apart rose and fell as one.

name: CRYSTALFIST-a-rate-stopped
old: export const RESONANCE_HZ = Object.freeze({ wave: 61 / 120, counter: 41 / 120, bounce: 59 / 120, beat: 1 });
new: export const RESONANCE_HZ = Object.freeze({ wave: 61 / 120, counter: 41 / 120, bounce: 0, beat: 1 });
note: AUDIT: a bounce of nothing is whole over any clock - the columns stop bouncing; resonanceRatesWhole refuses a stopped rate.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-auras-colour
old: export const RESONANCE_RGB = Object.freeze({ purple: Object.freeze(CRYSTAL_PURPLE.slice(0, 3)) });
new: export const RESONANCE_RGB = Object.freeze({ purple: Object.freeze([0.698, 0.302, 1]) });
note: The ward's violet, not the Crystal Fist's purple - and a second literal beside the title's.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-beat-dropped
old: return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 0.08 + 0.34 * wave + 0.28 * counter * bounce + 0.3 * beat * (0.4 + 0.6 * h2)));
new: return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 0.08 + 0.34 * wave + 0.28 * counter * bounce));
note: AUDIT: no beat through the columns - the recorded levels catch it.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-counts-ignored
note: AUDIT: every column drawn to its top, whatever node's law counts.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-counts-not-handed
note: AUDIT: the draw never hands the resonance its counts: the shader draws whatever the last wearer left.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-seed-ignored
old: export const resonanceClock = (seconds, seed) => auraClock(seconds) + (Number.isFinite(seed) ? seed : 0) * AURA_CLOCK_PERIOD;
note: AUDIT: every wearer on the frame's clock: two wearers side by side rise and fall as one.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-count-off-by-one
note: One square over each column's top lit.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-gap-filled
note: Bars, not squares: the gap between them filled.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-fade-dropped
old: return mix(e.x * e.y, avg, smoothstep(0.35, 0.7, px / min(pitchX, pitchY)));
note: AUDIT: far off, the rows of squares drawn as they are near - they moire and shimmer as the eye moves.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-kindle-dropped
note: The columns stand whole the moment it kindles, instead of rising out of the ground.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-foot-unlit-while-kindling
note: AUDIT: the level's floor taken below nothing - kindling, a column's foot not yet out of the ground. (The Math.max(1, ...) guard this record first mutated was dead code - the floor already keeps every kindled column's foot lit - and is gone.)

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-feet-dropped
old: float c = resCover(vec2((fract(cu) - 0.5) * pitch, r - uRingR), pitch, RES_PITCH) * uKindle;
note: No square at a column's foot on the ground.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-feet-off-their-columns
old: float c = resCover(vec2((fract(cu) - 0.5) * pitch, r - uRingR), pitch, RES_PITCH) * uKindle;
new: float c = resCover(vec2(fract(cu) * pitch, r - uRingR), pitch, RES_PITCH) * uKindle;
note: The feet between the columns, not under them.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-rings-guard-dropped
note: AUDIT: the ground answered at the middle, where atan(0, 0) is no number - a NaN the premultiplied blend paints white.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-dispatch
note: The resonance drawn as Dagon's fire.

name: CRYSTALFIST-added-not-covered
note: AUDIT: added (ONE, ONE): a square over its foot, the far wall through the near and a bright ground sum past the purple to a pale pink.

name: CRYSTALFIST-the-ring-on-the-fire
note: AUDIT: the ring over the fire's (0.85 m), inside the old pin's 0.9 - held strictly inside it now.
